command(py -c '
import subprocess, json, sys

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
url = "https://www.youtube.com/@sensebar/videos"
cmd = ["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "-J", url]
print("Fetching video list from @sensebar...")
res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
if res.returncode != 0:
    print("Error:", res.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

data = json.loads(res.stdout)
entries = data.get("entries", [])
print(f"Total videos found: {len(entries)}")

keywords = ["claude", "codex", "antigravity", "opencode", "open code"]
matched = []
for entry in entries:
    title = entry.get("title", "")
    video_id = entry.get("id", "")
    url = f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"
    lower_title = title.lower()
    for kw in keywords:
        if kw in lower_title:
            matched.append((entry, kw))
            break

print(f"Matched videos: {len(matched)}")
for entry, kw in matched:
    print(f"- [{kw}] {entry.get(\"title\")} -> https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={entry.get(\"id\")}")
')

command(py -c '
import json
with open("sensebar_matched.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
matched_ids = {item["id"] for item in data["matched"]}

import subprocess
cmd = ["yt-dlp", "--flat-playlist", "-J", "https://www.youtube.com/@sensebar/videos"]
res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
entries = json.loads(res.stdout).get("entries", [])

print("Unmatched entries that might be related:")
related_words = ["ai", "agent", "gpt", "code", "gemini", "cursor", "copilot"]
for entry in entries:
    if entry["id"] not in matched_ids:
        title = entry.get("title", "")
        lt = title.lower()
        if any(w in lt for w in related_words):
            print(f"- {title} (id: {entry[\"id\"]})")
')
